body.zh-Hant: 尤塞維奧·阿亞拉生於1875年8月14日，出生地為巴拉圭的巴雷羅格蘭德（Barrero Grande）；1942年6月4日在布宜諾斯艾利斯去世。德國國家圖書館的人名檔稱他是政治人物與經濟學者。
body.en: Eusebio Ayala was born on 14 August 1875 at Barrero Grande, Paraguay and died in Buenos Aires on 4 June 1942. The German National Library authority record describes him as a politician and economist.

citations.quote: 1875-08-14, Barrero Grande, Paraguay
1942-06-04, Buenos Aires
Paraguay. Politiker und Wirtschaftswissenschaftler

body.zh-Hant: 人名權威檔記載他曾在1921至1923年與1932至1936年擔任巴拉圭總統。
body.en: The authority record states that he was president of Paraguay in 1921–1923 and again in 1932–1936.

citations.quote: 1921-1923 und 1932-1936 Präsident von Paraguay
citations.evidenceNote: 年精度；段落迄點取 1936 的下一年起日

body.zh-Hant: 1913年4月5日，阿亞拉以外交部長身分在亞松森的外交部與玻利維亞公使里卡多·穆希亞會面，同意簽署一份議定書；條文要求雙方在兩年內談判確定的邊界條約。美國公使的後續公文把這份協定稱為阿亞拉—穆希亞議定書，並說它規定兩國在查科維持現狀兩年。
body.en: On 5 April 1913 Ayala, as Foreign Minister, met Bolivia's envoy Ricardo Mujía at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Asunción and agreed to sign a protocol; its first article bound both sides to negotiate a definitive boundary treaty within two years. A later US legation despatch calls the agreement the Ayala-Mujía protocol and says it keeps the status quo in the Chaco for two years.

citations.quote: on April 5, 1913, meeting at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Dr. Eusebio Ayala, Foreign Minister, agreed to sign the following Protocol
Dr. Ricardo Mujía, Envoy Extraordinary and Minister Plenipotentiary of Bolivia
negotiate a definitive boundary treaty within two years
known as the Ayala-Mujía protocol
maintain the status quo in the Chaco for two years

body.zh-Hant: 1918年12月10日的美國駐巴拉圭公使公文稱，阿亞拉當時是巴拉圭外交部長，公使在該日上午拜會了他。公文轉述阿亞拉的話：巴拉圭政府特別希望南美各共和國嚴格維持友好關係。
body.en: A US legation despatch dated 10 December 1918 identifies Ayala as Paraguay's Minister for Foreign Affairs and says the minister called on him on the morning of that day. The despatch reports Ayala as saying that the Paraguayan government was especially anxious to see friendly relations between the South American republics strictly maintained.

citations.quote: December 10, 1918
Dr. Eusebio Ayala, Paraguayan Minister for Foreign Affairs
on the morning of December 10th
Dr. Ayala told me that, particularly at this time
especially anxious to see a strict maintenance of friendly relations

body.zh-Hant: 1921年9月23日的美國代辦公文說，美巴引渡條約的原件由尼古拉·A·格雷夫斯塔德與阿亞拉簽署，且有英文與西班牙文兩種文本。同年10月28日的公文附上阿亞拉的信，他寫道第二條第19款的兩種文本無法完全對應，並說偽證在巴拉圭法典中不受處罰；美國國務院的回覆稱他是代表巴拉圭簽署該條約的人。
body.en: A US chargé's despatch of 23 September 1921 says the original extradition treaty between the United States and Paraguay, signed by Nicolay A. Grevstad and Ayala, exists in both English and Spanish. A despatch of 28 October 1921 encloses Ayala's letter, which says the two texts of Article II No. 19 could not be made to coincide and that perjury is not punishable under the Paraguayan Code. The State Department's reply describes him as the signatory for Paraguay.

citations.quote: September 23, 1921
signed by Nicolay A. Grevstad and Doctor Eusebio Ayala
is in both English and Spanish
October 28, 1921
Article II No. 19 of the Treaty
it has not been possible to make the two texts coincide
Perjury is not punishable according to the Paraguayan Code

body.zh-Hant: 1927年12月6日美國駐阿根廷大使的公文載明，巴拉圭全權代表包括阿亞拉、何塞·P·瓜吉亞里與富爾亨西奧·R·莫雷諾。1928年12月7日駐巴拉圭公使的電報稱阿亞拉是前巴拉圭駐華盛頓公使，正前往蒙特維多，正式請烏拉圭政府召集岡德拉條約所定的調查委員會。
body.en: A US ambassador's despatch of 6 December 1927 lists the Paraguayan plenipotentiaries as Eusebio Ayala, José P. Guggiari and Fulgencio R. Moreno. A telegram of 7 December 1928 from the US minister in Paraguay calls Ayala a former Paraguayan Minister in Washington, on his way to Montevideo to ask the Uruguayan government to convoke the Commission of Inquiry provided for by the Gondra Treaty.

December 7, 1928

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任內的外交往來與政變
heading.en: Presidency, Chaco diplomacy and the 1936 coup

body.zh-Hant: 美國國務院1932年8月15日的電報指示公使就查科局勢與阿亞拉總統商談；1933年的公文註腳註明阿亞拉是巴拉圭總統。1936年2月20日的公使電報稱佛朗哥上校當天宣誓就任臨時總統，同一卷公文把這場政變的首要目標說成推翻阿亞拉—埃斯蒂加里維亞政權，1937年的公文則稱阿亞拉為前總統。
body.en: A State Department telegram of 15 August 1932 instructs the US minister to discuss the Chaco situation with President Ayala, and a 1933 despatch footnote identifies Eusebio Ayala as President of Paraguay. A telegram of 20 February 1936 reports that Colonel Franco took the oath as Provisional President that day; the same volume says the coup's first objective was to overthrow the Ayala-Estigarribia regime, and a 1937 despatch footnote calls Ayala a former President of Paraguay.

citations.quote: Aug. 15 (32) To the Minister in Paraguay

body.zh-Hant: 阿基萊·拉蒂（後來的庇護十一世）1857年5月31日生於米蘭附近的代西奧，1879年12月20日在拉特朗聖若望大殿晉鐸，1882年取得神學、教會法與哲學三項學位。他是米蘭安布羅夏納圖書館的學者，1907年出任館長，任職至1912年。
body.en: Achille Ratti, later Pius XI, was born at Desio near Milan on 31 May 1857 and was ordained a priest in the Basilica of St John Lateran on 20 December 1879. In 1882 he took degrees in theology, canon law and philosophy. A doctor of the Biblioteca Ambrosiana in Milan, he became its prefect in 1907 and remained there until 1912.

heading.zh-Hant: 梵蒂岡圖書館、波蘭與米蘭

body.zh-Hant: 1914年9月1日拉蒂升任梵蒂岡圖書館館長；1918年5月教宗本篤十五世派他赴波蘭與立陶宛任宗座視察員，1919年7月3日獲確認為宗座大使，同年10月28日在華沙受祝聖為總主教。1921年9月8日他在米蘭主教座堂舉行接掌米蘭教區的典禮，留在米蘭直到1922年2月初的教宗選舉會議為止。
body.en: Ratti became prefect of the Vatican Library on 1 September 1914. In May 1918 Benedict XV sent him to Poland and Lithuania as apostolic visitor; on 3 July 1919 he was confirmed as nuncio, and on 28 October he was consecrated archbishop in Warsaw. On 8 September 1921 he took possession of the diocese of Milan in a ceremony in the Duomo; he stayed there until the conclave of early February 1922.

body.zh-Hant: 1922年2月2日舉行的教宗選舉會議於2月6日結束，拉蒂在第十四輪投票中獲選教宗，取名庇護十一世。1929年2月11日簽署的條約中，義大利承認梵蒂岡城國在教宗主權之下；他於1939年2月10日去世。
body.en: The conclave that opened on 2 February 1922 closed on 6 February, and Ratti was elected pope on the fourteenth ballot, taking the name Pius XI. In the treaty signed on 11 February 1929 Italy recognised the Vatican City State under the sovereignty of the Supreme Pontiff. He died on 10 February 1939.

body.zh-Hant: 格賴瑟在普魯士波森省的小資產階級家庭長大，1914年9月以戰時志願兵加入海軍，1919年加入在波羅的海地區活動、屬「東部邊境防衛」的義勇軍。1922年起他是德意志社會黨（DSP）黨員，20年代在但澤自由市經商，1929年底加入納粹黨與衝鋒隊。
body.en: Greiser grew up in a lower-middle-class family in the Prussian province of Posen. He volunteered for the navy in September 1914 and in 1919 joined a Freikorps active in the Baltic and belonging to the 'Grenzschutz Ost'. From 1922 he was a member of the German-Social Party (DSP), worked as a merchant in the Free City of Danzig in the 1920s, and joined the NSDAP and SA at the end of 1929.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年至1933年格賴瑟擔任納粹黨在但澤人民議會的黨團主席，並在1930至1939年任但澤的副大區黨部領袖。1931至1933年他任《前哨》報總編輯；1933年6月起任參議院副議長兼內政參議員。
body.en: From 1930 to 1933 Greiser chaired the NSDAP group in the Danzig Volkstag, and from 1930 to 1939 he was deputy Gauleiter in Danzig. From 1931 to 1933 he was editor-in-chief of Der Vorposten. From June 1933 he served as deputy president of the Senate and senator for the interior.

body.zh-Hant: 1934年11月28日起格賴瑟任但澤參議院議長，至1939年9月1日止。他取代赫爾曼·勞施寧，成為但澤最高政府機關的首長。同時他仍是大區黨部領袖阿爾貝特·福爾斯特的副手，並自1934年起與他推動反波蘭、反猶政策。
body.en: Greiser was president of the Danzig Senate from 28 November 1934 until 1 September 1939. He succeeded Hermann Rauschning and stood at the head of the city's highest governing body. At the same time he remained deputy to Gauleiter Albert Forster and from 1934 drove anti-Polish and anti-Jewish policy with him.

heading.zh-Hant: 瓦爾特蘭帝國大區與審判

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月他轉任波森軍區的民政長官，10月任命為波森帝國大區（1940年起稱瓦爾特蘭）的大區黨部領袖兼帝國總督，並自1940年起為納粹黨帝國議會議員。他推行針對波蘭人、猶太人與天主教徒的日耳曼化政策。1946年他被引渡給波蘭，6月21日被判死刑，7月21日在波森城堡前公開處決。
body.en: In September 1939 Greiser became head of civil administration in the Posen military district, and in October he was appointed Gauleiter and Reichsstatthalter of Reichsgau Posen (Wartheland from 1940). From 1940 he was also an NSDAP Reichstag deputy. He pursued a rigid Germanisation policy directed against Poles, Jews and Catholics. Extradited to Poland in 1946, he was sentenced to death on 21 June and publicly executed before the Poznan citadel on 21 July.
